org: IIT Hyderabad — Natural Language & Information Processing Lab
summary: Localized school-level math word problems and children's stories from US/UK English to Indian English while preserving exact mathematical meaning and structure.
highlights: Built a high-quality synthetic parallel dataset using open-source LLMs under strict structural-alignment constraints.
Used the dataset to train and evaluate localization models for controlled dialect adaptation.
Applied results toward educational NLP tooling for Indian classrooms.

org: IIT Mandi — Centre for AI & Robotics (CAIR)
summary: Developed humanoid locomotion behaviors using imitation and reinforcement learning for human-like, stable gait synthesis.
highlights: Trained humanoid gaits with imitation learning (GAIL, TRPO) for human-like motion.
Processed motion-capture data to learn state–action policies directly from expert demonstrations.
Implemented and trained SAC, DDPG, and TD3 for bipedal walking, achieving stable, robust gait control in simulation.
